property_summary: For any Collect call and any adversarial caller, the reference C never allows a caller to extract more Ether than their recorded Acc balance permits, because nonReentrant_ locks during the external call; the mutant omits `locked_ = true`, so a re-entrant call can inflate the payout and reduce Acc[attacker].balance below what is consistent with one additional Put.
change_summary: Delete the locked_ = true assignment in nonReentrant_.
